glossEn: constituting the full quantity or extent; complete
note: constituting the full quantity or extent; complete。**只能作定语或表语，不能作名词**。线索：the entire family / be in ruins entire。修饰集合名词时是「全体的」，修饰不可数名词时是「全部的」，英文不区分。

glossZh: 全缘的（叶子/花瓣边缘完整）
glossEn: (of leaves or petals) having a smooth edge; not broken up into teeth or lobes
note: (of leaves or petals) having a smooth edge; not broken up into lobes。植物学义。现有中文无对应，属新增。
(used of domestic animals) sexually competent。畜牧学义。现有中文无对应，属新增，罕见。
